cells.message:
feat(api)!: rename orders route to /v1/checkout

BREAKING CHANGE: /v1/orders is replaced by /v1/checkout
for POST createOrder. Clients must migrate before
2026-06-01; after that date the old route returns 410.

feat(api)!: move POST /v1/orders to /v1/checkout

BREAKING CHANGE: the order creation endpoint now lives at
/v1/checkout. Migrate clients before 2026-06-01; /v1/orders
returns 410 afterwards.

feat(api)!: switch create order route to /v1/checkout

BREAKING CHANGE: clients calling POST /v1/orders must switch
to /v1/checkout by 2026-06-01. The old route returns 410
after that date.

feat(api)!: rename orders endpoint to checkout

BREAKING CHANGE: migrate /v1/orders to /v1/checkout before
2026-06-01; old route returns 410 after that date.

feat(api)!: replace /v1/orders with /v1/checkout

BREAKING CHANGE: POST /v1/orders is dropped after
2026-06-01. Point clients at /v1/checkout before then.

api: rename orders endpoint to checkout

POST /v1/orders previously registered the createOrder
handler; it now lives at POST /v1/checkout. Clients that
still call the old route receive 410 Gone after the
2026-06-01 migration deadline, so update callers to the new
path before then.

api: replace orders route with checkout route

The createOrder handler is now bound to POST /v1/checkout
instead of POST /v1/orders. The previous path is removed
and returns 410 Gone from 2026-06-01 onward; existing
clients must migrate to the new endpoint ahead of that
date.

api: move create order route to /v1/checkout

createOrder was registered at POST /v1/orders and is now
served at POST /v1/checkout. Old-route callers get 410 Gone
after the 2026-06-01 deadline, so switch clients to the new
path before migration day.

feat(api)!: rename /v1/orders to /v1/checkout

BREAKING CHANGE: POST /v1/orders is replaced by POST
/v1/checkout. All clients must migrate by 2026-06-01,
after which the old endpoint returns 410 Gone.

feat(api)!: change order creation endpoint to /v1/checkout

BREAKING CHANGE: the order creation route moves from
/v1/orders to /v1/checkout. Update clients before
2026-06-01; the old path returns 410 after that date.

refactor(api)!: move createOrder to /v1/checkout route

BREAKING CHANGE: /v1/orders is deprecated in favor of
/v1/checkout. Migrate all POST /v1/orders callers by
2026-06-01; the old route returns 410 Gone afterwards.
